question: **‘It was Bhagiratha, whose austere penance….’ The word ‘austere’ here means:**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Severe**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**austere**" means severe or strict. (कठोर या सख्त)
 
• It can refer to someone who lives a simple and disciplined life.
 
• It can also refer to something that is plain or unadorned.
